reviewStandard: Clinical-caution pages may not receive generic warning graphics, crossed-out foods or medicines, condition anatomy used as treatment evidence, elemental-metal or microorganism media substituted for a clinical protocol, stigmatizing patient imagery, or neonatal treatment scenes. All six routes fail before prompt creation.
promotionRule: No Batch 119 source hash exists or is eligible for promotion. All six routes remain asset-free scientific holds. No generated source, master, derivative, registry record, endpoint, Schema object, social preview, or image-sitemap entry may be created from this batch.
